_comment_setup: Run `python3 build.py --setup` instead of hand-editing this — it writes config/settings.json (gitignored) interactively and re-run anytime to change these. This file is just the checked-in template/fallback; build.py reads it automatically if settings.json doesn't exist yet, so none of this is required just to get started.
_comment_net_worth: Your total savings/investments as of your ledger's start date.
_comment_defaults: Used only for a month that has zero real entries of that kind — e.g. before you've filled in data/income.csv, or for a month you haven't backfilled yet. A month with any real entry is left alone; these never add to real data, only fill a gap.
_comment_categories: The dashboard shows these, in this order. Rename or reorder freely; every category used in rules.csv must appear here.
_comment_transfers: Matched case-insensitively against description + type. These are dropped from spending — a credit-card payment is money moving between your own accounts, not a purchase. Counting it would double-count everything you charged.
_comment_issuer_map: Fallback only, used when no rule in rules.csv matches. Left side is the issuer's own Category column value.
